notes.title: 1.1.1 - Bug Fix
notes.content:
I've just fixed a bug in the X-Sudoku puzzles.
There was an incorrect digit in X-Sudoku - Easy 1 - Puzzle 6. 
It has now been corrected.

Thanks to the vigilant sudoku solvers for telling me about this.
I'll do my best to fix any problems quickly, so please tell me if you find any bugs!

notes.title: 1.1.0 - X-Sudoku
notes.content:
It's time to expand [i]My Sudoku[/i], with a whole new game mode!

X-Sudoku is similar to the classic puzzle, with an extra diagonal challenge.

Update 1.1.0 includes a full set of free puzzles, as well as more DLC content when you're ready for more!
